pages.text: 今天是个大日子！爸爸妈妈要带咘咘去野生动物园啦！咘咘一大早就起来了，兴奋得蹦蹦跳跳：「我要看大象！我要看猴子！」NOMI 帮咘咘戴上太阳帽，Coco 在旁边拍着小爪子说：「Let's go! I can't wait!」
pages.text_en: Today is a big day! Dad and Mom are taking Bubu to the wildlife zoo! Bubu woke up early, bouncing with excitement: "I want to see elephants! I want to see monkeys!" NOMI helped Bubu put on her sun hat, while Coco clapped her paws: "Let's go! I can't wait!"

pages.text: 动物园的大门好大好漂亮！彩色的拱门上画满了各种动物。咘咘牵着爸爸妈妈的手，仰头看着高高的长颈鹿雕塑，眼睛瞪得圆圆的：「哇——好大呀！」NONO 飞到拱门顶上，叽叽喳喳地当起了瞭望员。
pages.text_en: The zoo entrance was magnificent! The colorful archway was decorated with all kinds of animals. Bubu held Dad and Mom's hands, looking up at the tall giraffe statue with wide eyes: "Wow — so big!" NONO flew to the top of the archway, chirping as a lookout.

pages.text: 第一站——小浣熊展区！NOMI 一看到围栏里的浣熊们，激动得尾巴都竖起来了：「这是我的家！看，都是我的家人！」围栏里的浣熊们正在水边洗东西，小爪子搓呀搓。咘咘趴在栏杆上看得入迷：「NOMI，它们在洗什么呀？」
pages.text_en: First stop — the raccoon exhibit! NOMI's tail stood straight up with excitement: "This is my home! Look, they're all my relatives!" The raccoons inside were washing things by the water, scrubbing with their little paws. Bubu leaned on the railing, mesmerized: "NOMI, what are they washing?"

pages.text: NOMI 骄傲地当起了导游：「我们浣熊最爱干净啦！什么东西都要洗一洗才放心。」一只小浣熊好奇地走过来，隔着围栏和 NOMI 对视，两只浣熊歪着头互相打量。咘咘笑得直拍手：「它认出你啦！」
pages.text_en: NOMI proudly became a tour guide: "We raccoons love being clean! We wash everything to feel safe." A little raccoon curiously walked over, staring at NOMI through the fence. The two raccoons tilted their heads at each other. Bubu clapped with laughter: "It recognizes you!"

pages.text: 第二站——小熊猫展区！Coco 一进来就激动得跳了起来：「My family! Look, Bubu, red pandas!」红棕色的小熊猫们有的在树上爬来爬去，有的卷着蓬松的尾巴在睡觉。Coco 指着最高那棵树上的小熊猫说：「That one looks just like my grandpa!」
pages.text_en: Second stop — the red panda exhibit! Coco jumped with excitement: "My family! Look, Bubu, red pandas!" The reddish-brown red pandas were climbing trees and napping with their fluffy tails curled up. Coco pointed at one on the highest branch: "That one looks just like my grandpa!"

pages.text: 咘咘仔细看看树上的小熊猫，又看看身边的 Coco，惊奇地说：「真的耶！和 Coco 长得一模一样！」Coco 得意地摸摸自己的黄色围巾：「But I'm the only one with a scarf! That makes me special!」爸爸笑着给它们拍了张合影。
pages.text_en: Bubu looked carefully at the red panda in the tree, then at Coco beside her: "It's true! They look just like Coco!" Coco proudly touched her yellow scarf: "But I'm the only one with a scarf! That makes me special!" Dad laughed and took a photo of them together.

pages.text: 到了喂斑马的地方！咘咘拿着一根胡萝卜，小心翼翼地伸出手。斑马低下头，长长的舌头卷走了胡萝卜，舔了咘咘的手心一下。「哈哈哈哈好痒！」咘咘缩回手，笑得停不下来。妈妈在旁边温柔地扶着她：「再来一根？」
pages.text_en: Time to feed the zebras! Bubu carefully held out a carrot. The zebra lowered its head, its long tongue scooped up the carrot and licked Bubu's palm. "Hahaha so ticklish!" Bubu pulled back her hand, laughing non-stop. Mom gently held her: "Want to try another one?"

pages.text: 喂羊驼更好玩！毛茸茸的羊驼把脸凑过来，大大的眼睛看着咘咘，嘴巴一动一动的。咘咘伸手摸了摸羊驼的脸，软软的像棉花糖。「它的毛好软呀！」Coco 也伸出小爪子摸了一下：「So fluffy! Like a cloud!」
pages.text_en: Feeding the alpacas was even more fun! The fluffy alpaca leaned its face close, gazing at Bubu with its big eyes, mouth moving gently. Bubu touched its face — soft like cotton candy. "Its fur is so soft!" Coco reached out too: "So fluffy! Like a cloud!"

pages.text: 走着走着，前方一片蓝绿色的光芒！一只孔雀正在开屏！巨大的尾羽像一面彩色的扇子，上面点缀着蓝色和绿色的「眼睛」。咘咘惊呆了，张着嘴巴说不出话。Coco 也看呆了：「Wow, a peacock! So beautiful! It's like a rainbow!」
pages.text_en: As they walked along, a brilliant blue-green shimmer appeared ahead! A peacock was displaying its tail! The enormous feathers fanned out like a colorful screen, dotted with blue and green "eyes." Bubu was stunned speechless. Coco gasped: "Wow, a peacock! So beautiful! It's like a rainbow!"

pages.text: 猴山到了！猴子们在树上荡来荡去，跳来跳去，比咘咘还调皮。一只小猴子突然跑到围栏边，对着咘咘做鬼脸——吐舌头、挤眼睛！咘咘也对它做鬼脸，两个小家伙隔着围栏互相扮鬼脸，NOMI 在旁边笑得肚子疼。
pages.text_en: The monkey hill! Monkeys were swinging and jumping between trees, even naughtier than Bubu. A little monkey ran to the fence and made a funny face at Bubu — tongue out, eyes crossed! Bubu made a face back, and they made faces at each other while NOMI laughed until her tummy hurt.

pages.text: 午饭时间！爸爸买了爆米花和棉花糖。粉红色的棉花糖比咘咘的脸还大！咘咘咬了一口，甜丝丝的棉花糖在嘴里化开来。NONO 偷偷啄了一小口棉花糖，嘴巴被粘住了，急得扑棱翅膀。大家都笑了。
pages.text_en: Lunchtime! Dad bought popcorn and cotton candy. The pink cotton candy was bigger than Bubu's face! Bubu took a bite and the sweet candy melted in her mouth. NONO secretly pecked a bit of cotton candy and got his beak stuck, flapping his wings in panic. Everyone laughed.

pages.text: 下午看马戏表演！一只海狮用鼻子顶着球转圈圈，小狗穿着彩色衣服跳过一个个圆圈。咘咘使劲鼓掌：「好厉害！好厉害！」NOMI 也跟着拍手，NONO 在头顶飞来飞去当啦啦队。Coco 举着小旗子喊：「Bravo! Bravo!」
pages.text_en: Afternoon circus show! A sea lion balanced a ball on its nose, spinning around. Dogs in colorful outfits jumped through hoops. Bubu clapped hard: "Amazing! Amazing!" NOMI clapped along, NONO flew overhead as a cheerleader, and Coco waved a little flag: "Bravo! Bravo!"

pages.text: 表演结束后，他们去看了长颈鹿。长颈鹿的脖子好长好长，低下头来的时候，鼻子几乎碰到了咘咘的太阳帽！「它在闻我的帽子！」咘咘咯咯笑着。妈妈赶紧拿出手机拍下这个珍贵瞬间。
pages.text_en: After the show, they visited the giraffes. The giraffe's neck was so incredibly long. When it lowered its head, its nose almost touched Bubu's sun hat! "It's sniffing my hat!" Bubu giggled. Mom quickly took out her phone to capture this precious moment.

pages.text: 大象也好有趣！大象用长长的鼻子卷起水，「噗——」喷了出来！水花洒在空中变成一道小彩虹。咘咘惊喜地叫起来：「彩虹！大象会变魔术！」NOMI 赶紧躲到 Sam 爸爸身后，生怕被水喷到。
pages.text_en: The elephants were fascinating too! An elephant scooped up water with its trunk and — splash! — sprayed it out! The water droplets caught the sunlight and formed a little rainbow. Bubu exclaimed: "A rainbow! The elephant does magic!" NOMI quickly hid behind Dad, afraid of getting splashed.

pages.text: 最后一站——纪念品商店！架子上摆满了各种毛绒动物玩偶。咘咘挑来挑去，最后抱起了一只浣熊玩偶和一只小熊猫玩偶：「这只送给 NOMI！这只送给 Coco！」NOMI 接过浣熊玩偶感动得眼睛亮晶晶的，Coco 抱着小熊猫玩偶说：「Thank you, Bubu! Best gift ever!」
pages.text_en: Last stop — the gift shop! The shelves were full of plush animal toys. Bubu looked around and finally picked up a raccoon plushie and a red panda plushie: "This one is for NOMI! This one is for Coco!" NOMI's eyes sparkled with emotion, and Coco hugged her red panda plushie: "Thank you, Bubu! Best gift ever!"

pages.text: 夕阳把天空染成了橘红色。一家人走出动物园大门，咘咘一手抱着浣熊玩偶，一手抱着小熊猫玩偶。上了车，咘咘靠在妈妈肩膀上，眼皮越来越重……「今天……好开心……」话还没说完，就睡着了。
pages.text_en: The sunset painted the sky orange-red. The family walked out through the zoo gates. Bubu held the raccoon plushie in one arm and the red panda plushie in the other. In the car, she leaned on Mom's shoulder, eyelids growing heavy... "Today... was so fun..." Before she could finish, she fell asleep.

pages.text: 在梦里，动物园的动物们都排成一排和咘咘挥手。斑马、羊驼、孔雀、猴子、长颈鹿、大象……它们一起笑着说：「再来玩呀！」NOMI 和 Coco 在梦里也变回了动物园里的样子，站在各自的家族中间，朝咘咘招手：「下次再来找我们的家人玩！」
pages.text_en: In her dream, all the zoo animals lined up and waved at Bubu. Zebras, alpacas, peacocks, monkeys, giraffes, elephants... They all smiled and said: "Come play again!" NOMI and Coco stood among their own families in the dream, waving at Bubu: "Come visit our relatives again next time!"
